lines: The underground city of Yomihara. In one corner of it sat a Chinese restaurant called Wei Long.
Senshu
Um, let me just gather up the table condiments for now...
Senshu
That's right, I need to wipe down this area before Shuntao gets back from taking out the trash.
In the restaurant after closing, the one doing the cleanup and cleaning was the prostitute 'Yuri Hisui'... no, the part-time employee 'Igawa Senshu'.
She had lost even the meaning of her life under the weight of her own sins and was living in self-abandonment...
But ever since her fellow prostitute, Ferma, who had taken an interest in her, introduced her to this place, she had been gradually regaining a positive outlook.
It had only been a few days since she started working, but Senshu was diligently learning the job and getting it done.
Bang bang bang bang!
Senshu
Huh!... Oh, it's just the TV.
At that moment, the sudden sound of gunfire made Senshu instinctively brace herself.
However, she quickly realized the sound was coming from the television in the shop and turned her gaze toward it.
An action movie set in some Southeast Asian country was playing.
It was a scene where a nun from the Violent Church, feared even by gangs, was systematically gunning down the thugs who had attacked her.
Senshu
Mm...? That was... no, I must be imagining things.
Among the extras playing the thugs, she thought she saw a one-eyed man she had seen somewhere before...
But more than that, Senshu was captivated by the flashy action.
At first glance, it looked like a gory, splatter-filled B-movie with bad taste...
But at its core, it depicted the tragedy and human drama of those who live in the underworld with great depth.
It was as if it were showing the very image of themselves, living in Yomihara right now...
Senshu
What was the title again... um, Black Lag...
Creak, creak creak
Senshu
Oh no, I can't keep watching. Shuntao will be back soon...
Senshu, who had been about to get lost in the screen, snapped back to reality at the sound of the back door opening and returned to her work.
And a few days later.
Senshu
Ugh, I actually bought it. Even the white scabbard... just like "that person's."
Senshu
It's the end of the year, isn't it? Let's all have some fun. Please, try to keep your petty jealousy in check.
Senshu
Fufu, just kidding, just kidding~
In this short period, Senshu had completely fallen for "Black Lagoon."
Specifically, a man who was formerly a yakuza and had retired for a time, but due to a bizarre fate returned to the underworld, and ultimately met his end... surprisingly, he was a good cook.
She was so deeply immersed in the character "Matsuzaki Ginji" that she had sunk into the pit.
At first, it was just quoting his lines during work or in casual chats with Hazuki and the others.
Before she knew it, she had started buying accessories, clothes, and sunglasses that matched his image...
And on this day, she finally went to Yomihara's black market to purchase a sword in a white scabbard.
Senshu walked down the back alley in high spirits, clutching the white scabbard to her chest as if it were precious.
Thug 1
--And then, to the Aji Dragon... Ah, that's right.
Senshu
Huh!?
However, the word "Aji Dragon" that suddenly drifted to her ears made her face twitch, and she stopped in her tracks.
She was a skilled and cunning Taimanin; the relaxed otaku demeanor from moments before vanished as if it had never existed, and in an instant she erased her presence and sharpened her senses.
Thug 2
Are you seriously planning to harass them again?! It's not like we're going to make any money out of it!
Thug 1
Shit, my voice is too loud...
It seemed a group of small-time thugs had gathered in a nearby abandoned building and were in the middle of some shady scheme.
Senshu pressed her ear against the wall to listen to their conversation.
They appeared to be a group of thugs who had previously been hired by Nys to harass the Aji Dragon.
It became clear that they had ultimately been defeated by Shuntao and were now harboring a grudge against her.
The voices were unfamiliar to Senshu, so she judged that they were a harassment group that had existed even before she came to the Aji Dragon.
Thug 1
And apparently, they're trying to make peace with them now.
Thug 2
What? At least if they'd just been crushed, we could have felt some satisfaction!
Senshu
(Senshu: (They talk so freely... They have no idea how hard those girls have been trying.)
Thug 3
But even if we go back to Aji Dragon to harass them, we'll just get driven off again in the end, right?
Thug 1
No, no. That's exactly it. Nys is still alive. We failed before, after all.
Thug 1
He's probably lost interest in us and forgotten all about this by now.
Thug 2
Huh? What do you mean?
Thug 1
I mean, this time we'll loudly declare that we are Nys's hired hands.
Thug 1
They're still in the phase where their bond is thin. We're going to shatter it.
Thug 1
Aji Dragon will think they've been betrayed, and Nys will know it's because of his contract, but he'll never admit it... It's a complete break.
Senshu
(What did you say... This is bad.)
Fragile relationships of trust can sometimes create more troublesome situations than outright hostility.
Senshu, the daughter of the legendary woman Hatori Seishu, knew this better than anyone.
This was not a problem that could be solved by simply defeating them. If she did not stop this here, it would be over.
Senshu
(If it were me now...)
Senshu took a fresh look at her current appearance.
Not a Taimanin suit, not a prostitute's outfit, not even an Aji Dragon employee uniform, but a costume resembling a character from a movie.
The weapon in her hand was a white-sheathed sword she had only acquired today, a type she would never normally handle.
Most importantly, they did not know her face yet, so pretending to be uninvolved would not be difficult.
Senshu
Hah!
Thug 1
Wha-?! What the hell, who are you?!
Senshu, having made her decision, acted swiftly, kicking the wall of the abandoned building to create a loud noise.
Surrounded by the punks who burst out in a jumble, she smoothly drew her sword from the white sheath.
Thug 2
I asked who you are, so answer! Are you on drugs or something?!
Senshu
(...I have no obligation to answer, but here...)
Senshu
I am... Matsuzaki Gin. Everyone, please stand down.
Senshu
(I'm sorry, Gin. For using your name without permission.)
Senshu
(But I want to act like a completely different person so I don't get recognized as me, so please let me imitate you for a bit.)
Senshu
Oh, it's nothing. I just heard a bit of scheming drifting on the underground wind from Yomihara.
Senshu
This Gin here can't stand the scum who try to interfere with honest business.
Senshu
This Matsuzaki Gin isn't going to run or hide. I caught you trespassing!
Thug 4
Gyaa!
Thug 1
Guh, is this guy playing hero? We outnumber him, take him down!
Senshu
(Hmph, if they had just done that while I was leisurely giving my speech.)
Senshu
(That's why they can't even properly handle petty harassment jobs.)
Like a wandering swordsman from a yakuza story, Senshu shouted a battle cry and slashed at the nearest man.
The punks who took the hit finally started counterattacking in a disorganized manner, but...
They had no coordination to speak of, just charging in sporadically and getting cut down one after another.
Senshu
Haah! Yaaah!
Thugs
"Gyaa!" "Guh!" "Ugh!"
Senshu
(Good, just a few more... I was a bit nervous with my first weapon, but this is fine.)
And just as she was keeping up the momentum, thinning them out to incapacitate everyone, at that moment.
Thug 5
Hey, what's going on with you guys!
Thug 1
Y-you're back, thank god! We'll explain later, beat the crap out of her!
Thug 6
...Hmph, I see. Looks like you've been giving our buddies a pretty rough time.
Senshu
(What did you say?!)
Several men who had apparently gone to the main street for supplies joined the punks.
Their group wasn't just the ones inside the abandoned building.
Senshu
(There are over twenty of them. For a mere gang of punks...)
Senshu
(And with this many of them, doing low-level work like harassment... I couldn't have predicted this!)
Thug 1
All at once, you bastards!
Senshu
Nngh... Aaah!
Ginn! Gah! Zashu!
Senshu
Haa, haa, haa.
Senshu
Ah, damn it... that coat I just bought... Do you have any idea how long it took me to find one that was an exact match?
Numbers are not to be taken lightly. Especially when it comes to simple "violence."
Of course, normally, Senshu wouldn't even spare a glance at a dozen or so lowlifes from Yomihara's slums.
But right now, she wasn't even using her signature poison techniques. She had to mimic Ginjirou's movements so precisely that even her subtlest mannerisms wouldn't give her away.
Moreover, the white sheath she bought at the black market was, as expected, a shoddy piece of junk.
She hadn't expected it to be practical from the start, but it was so brittle that a careless slash would snap it right off.
That burden was more than enough to bridge the desperate gap in combat power.
Thug 13
Hahhh!
Senshu
Fwhoo...
Senshu exhaled deeply as she deflected, swept aside, and turned the tables on the lowlifes lunging at her one after another.
Senshu
It's okay, I won't lose. But after it's all over... will I still be able to stand on my own feet...
In Yomihara's back alleys, where people fight for survival, exposing yourself without defense means getting stripped bare without mercy.
Being unable to act is synonymous with mutual destruction.
Senshu
But maybe that's fine... if it means I can protect those girls.
Shuntao, Hazuki, Xiaolei.
Through her interactions with them, Senshu was beginning to stop "living to die."
Living to atone... that forward-looking sentiment was gradually taking root.
But it was still a little "lacking."
She needed a bit more time before she could truly, from the bottom of her heart, wish to "live."
...If things had been different.
Senshu
But if it were Gin-san...
In Black Lagoon, Ginjirou tried to live at the very last moment. He "decided" to live.
And that became his opening, leading to the fatal blow from Revy.
But even so... Senshu came to love Ginjirou for having chosen to "live" with Yukio at the very last moment.
The slight lack of "will to live" in Senshu was now filled by the existence of "Matsuzaki Ginjirou."
And the thugs surrounding them were not the kind of skilled dual-wielders who could turn that slight wavering of resolve into a fatal blow.
Senshu
Haaaaah!
Thug 14
W-what the hell, why is she suddenly...!
Senshu
Do you really want to see my blade that badly...!
Thug 15
Huh? A...? What are you...
Senshu
Everyone, get along nicely
Senshu
and trample the Ten Million Earth
Thugs
Guaaaaaah!?
One after another, screams and spurts of blood rose from the thugs.
Senshu, shifting from her previous cramped fighting style, freely wielded the white sheath in her hand.
The thought of it breaking was no longer there.
Life in the face of death. By wishing to live while accepting death, Senshu began to overwhelm the thugs once again.
It was just like when he raided the Hotel Moscow Japan branch office in the work, driving them to total annihilation.
Thug 24
Haa, haa, aaaaa!
And the last of the remaining thugs pulled out his gun and fired at Senshu.
Senshu
Haaaaah!
But Senshu flashed the white sheath.
Thug 24
Wha...!? ...Gyaaaaah!!
Startled by the fact that she had taken no damage, Senshu closed the distance in an instant and beheaded him.
And only then did the blade of the white sheath in her hand snap with a crack and fall.
As if she had been protected by some power until that very last moment.
Thug 24
N-No way... to cut... bullets... how... gah...
Senshu
......No way. It's not Ginjirou-san. No matter how skilled a Taimanin I am, swordsmanship is not my strong suit. I can't cut bullets on reflex.
Senshu
You missed, you know.
Senshu
(Fufu, if I think about it that way... Ginjirou-san really is amazing, isn't he?)
Looking at the bullet hole embedded in the abandoned building, caused by his panicked aim...
Senshu picked up her tattered coat, pulled it back on, and walked away.
